conclusion: The three inventories total 100 g in every trial. Warm and equal-temperature lids collected no water. At 300 s, faster return left 0.009270 g on the lid versus 0.049234 g with slower return. The chosen maintained-temperature and first-order transfer model is not a physical droplet-detachment or heat-flow experiment.
prediction: A cooler lid will collect water once vapour pressure crosses its threshold. Faster return should reduce lid storage at matched time, without changing the total 100 g.
